questions.question: Which systems will the agent call, who owns each, and where are their docs?
questions.recommended: One: the café's booking system, owned by Sunrise Café, with no docs. Its calls hold a table, book the held table, release a hold, and search free tables.
questions.reply: Yes. It is our own booking system and there are no docs.

questions.question: What is the largest party the agent may book?
questions.recommended: 8 people. For a larger party the agent says the maximum is 8 and asks for a new party size.

questions.question: When may the agent book?
questions.recommended: Only after the visitor says yes to the full proposal: café, date, time, party size and name. If any of these changes after the yes, the visitor must say yes again.

questions.question: How long does the booking system keep a table held?
questions.reply: An unconfirmed hold expires 10 minutes after it was placed.

questions.question: Your booking system has no docs, so I compared it with common booking systems. In those, a call that gets no answer may still have done its work. If that holds here, a hold call with no answer may have held the table, and a booking call with no answer may have booked it; the agent then proposes nothing on an unanswered hold and never resends an unanswered booking. Is that how your system behaves? Claims put to the owner: C-02, C-04.
questions.recommended: Yes: an unanswered hold or booking call may have done its work.

questions.question: The table's hold can expire before the booking call, and then the agent holds again and asks again. Nothing ends that. What ends it?
questions.recommended: The agent holds again once. If the hold expires a second time, it tells the visitor the table could not be booked.

questions.question: When the booking call gets no answer, the agent cannot tell whether the table was booked. What should it do?
questions.recommended: Send no second booking call, tell the visitor it is not known whether the table was booked, and ask them to call the café.

questions.question: Can the agent change or cancel a reservation that already exists?
questions.recommended: No. It only makes new reservations; it tells the visitor it cannot change one.
